authoring: Hand-written from the committed amara-life-v1 text before any contextual-synopsis run on this corpus. Each relevant_slugs list names every page that states the requested fact. When the corpus plants conflicting or outdated values for one fact, every page carrying a value is relevant. evidence lists case-insensitive substrings; --validate requires the pages containing all of them to equal relevant_slugs exactly, so a missing or extra label fails the check. Queries paraphrase the source where practical so that literal phrase matching is not the only route to the page.
